system.description: A device for training troops in sword and shield techniques. A pell is generally a stout wooden post, man-height and about 6" to 1' in diameter, planted firmly in the ground. The trainee practices striking the pell with a wooden sword and shield. The cost of pells is already included in the training costs for infantry troops. A pell weighs 15 – 30 stone (150 – 300 lbs).
